outcome_evidence: The drawer is initially closed (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot approaches and aligns with its handle (frames 30–105, wrist_image), then engages the handle and pulls outward. The drawer visibly extends from the cabinet during frames 134–154 (image and left_ego_image). It remains open after the gripper releases and withdraws at frames 175–182 (image, left_ego_image and wrist_image). No failed acquisition, harmful collision or unintended object displacement is visibly established.
